name: Are there any common reasons why kitchen faucets leak, even new ones?

mainEntity.name: Are there any common reasons why kitchen faucets leak, even new ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even new kitchen faucets can leak due to several factors, including faulty installation, manufacturing defects in components like O-rings or cartridges, or issues with water pressure. Incorrectly tightened connections during installation are a frequent cause. For a new faucet experiencing issues, it's important to verify the warranty and consider professional installation if it was a DIY project, as this can affect eligibility for repairs. CG Plumbing Solutions can assess the cause and provide solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: New faucets can leak from faulty installation, manufacturing defects, or water pressure issues. Check warranty or consider professional help if DIY caused it.
